description: Create a new blog post with title, HTML content, author, collection, tags, metadata, slug, image, and publishing options. status=published makes the post live. collection_id is optional; omit it to use the empty-slug default Posts collection. If that default does not exist, provide collection_id (call list_collections or create_collection).

authorId.description: Optional author user ID from list_blog_members. Assigning another member requires owner or admin access.

blogId.description: Blog ID. Use list_blogs to discover available blog IDs.

collection_id.description: Optional collection ID. When omitted, the collection with an empty slug is used. If none exists, use list_collections to choose a collection_id, or create_collection to create one first.

image.description: Optional featured image path or URL. Use upload_image for local files.

metadata.description: Custom metadata entries as key/value objects. Maximum 20 entries; description should be 200 characters or fewer.

published_at.description: Optional publish datetime in ISO 8601 format.

slug.description: Post slug. Auto-generated from title when omitted.

name: create_post
title: Create post
